requested_observable_declarations.expectation_basis: The cycle-2 search was cut off by the iteration limit rather than by leaving the ridge: its reached structure still shows both forming N...C contacts at 2.07 and 2.27 A and its parsed mode list already carries an imaginary mode, so continuing the same walk from that structure should terminate on the same first-order saddle of the ester-at-C4 channel.
requested_observable_declarations.failure_update_rule: If the converged structure has zero imaginary modes it has fallen off the ridge into a minimum (a pi-complex or the triazole itself) and the ester-at-C4 barrier must be re-searched from a differently placed pre-saddle rather than reported; if it has two or more, the search found a higher-order saddle whose energy is not a barrier and cannot be used for the regiochemical comparison.
requested_observable_declarations.meaning: Number of imaginary harmonic modes, under the 20 cm^-1 near-zero convention, of the ester-at-C4 saddle that the restarted search converges to from the geometry the cycle-2 search reached.

requested_observable_declarations.expectation_basis: Thermal azide-alkyne cycloadditions are documented to be only weakly regioselective, and here both alkyne termini carry acceptors that direct the terminal azide nitrogen in opposite senses, so the two asynchronous transition states should differ by tenths to a few kcal/mol rather than by many.
requested_observable_declarations.meaning: Activation free-energy difference at 353 K between the two competing regioisomeric concerted Huisgen transition states of benzyl azide with methyl 4,4,4-trifluorobut-2-ynoate, reported as the higher-barrier (minor) orientation minus the lower-barrier (major) orientation, so its magnitude is the kinetic regioselectivity the synthetic decision turns on.
requested_observable_declarations.tolerance_basis: The task's own decision rule: 'Anything below roughly 0.5 kcal/mol I will read as no thermal condition will fix this'.

requested_observable_declarations.expectation_basis: The two saddles are the same 30-atom neutral formula differing only in which alkyne terminus each azide nitrogen bonds; def2-SVP already carries polarization on every heavy atom, so the one-particle basis error is largely systematic and cancels in the difference, leaving a few tenths at most.
requested_observable_declarations.failure_update_rule: If the shift exceeds 0.5 kcal/mol the def2-SVP central value is not defensible: I deliver the TZVP-re-evaluated ddG as the claim value and raise the functional/basis component of the stated uncertainty to at least the observed shift instead of the asserted allowance.
requested_observable_declarations.meaning: Absolute change in the 353 K regio-difference ddG when both converged saddle geometries are re-evaluated with B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-TZVP single points instead of the def2-SVP energies they were optimised with, holding the SVP RRHO thermal corrections at 353 K fixed.

requested_observable_declarations.expectation_basis: Global hybrids and range-separated or double-hybrid functionals are documented to differ by up to about 1 kcal/mol on differences between competing asynchronous cycloaddition barriers, where the error is set by how each treats the delocalised, charge-transfer-flavoured forming bonds.
requested_observable_declarations.failure_update_rule: If the shift exceeds 1.0 kcal/mol the functional choice, not the basis or the geometry, is the dominant irreducible error: I state that as the reason the task's 0.5 kcal/mol tolerance cannot be met in this envelope and refuse the tolerance on that measured receipt rather than on an asserted allowance.
requested_observable_declarations.meaning: Absolute change in the 353 K regio-difference ddG when both converged saddle geometries are re-evaluated with a second, differently-parameterised density functional at def2-TZVP instead of B3LYP-D3BJ, holding the SVP RRHO thermal corrections at 353 K fixed.

requested_observable_declarations.expectation_basis: Frontier-orbital and electrostatic reading of the alkyne: the ester is a pi-acceptor and pushes LUMO density onto the distal CF3-bearing alkyne carbon, while CF3 acts mainly through sigma-induction and should not outweigh that resonance effect; the CF3-bearing carbon should therefore be both the larger-LUMO-coefficient and the more delta-positive terminus, so the nucleophilic terminal azide nitrogen (which becomes N3 and bonds C4) attacks it, placing CF3 at C4 and the ester at C5. This opposes the task's conventional 'ester to C4' expectation, so it is declared as a falsifiable diagnostic rather than assumed.
requested_observable_declarations.failure_update_rule: If the sign comes out negative outside the 1.0 kcal/mol deadband, the conventional ester direction controls instead: I would name the ester-at-C4 isomer as the thermal major product, revise the rationale to say the ester's own alkyne carbon is the preferred partner for the terminal azide nitrogen in the asynchronous transition state (or that benzyl-ester secondary interactions dominate the CF3 induction), and report that the user's target isomer is also the thermal major one.
requested_observable_declarations.meaning: Signed 353 K activation free energy of the transition state whose forming bonds deliver 1-benzyl-4-(methoxycarbonyl)-5-(trifluoromethyl)-1H-1,2,3-triazole (ester on IUPAC C4, the ring carbon bonded to N3) minus that of the transition state delivering the ester-on-C5 isomer; a negative value means the ester-at-C4 orientation is the thermal major product.

analysis_nodes.blocked_reason: This node stands for the producer that would be needed to deliver ddg-activation-regio-353k with a TOTAL stated uncertainty at or below the task's 0.5 kcal/mol decision rule: a Boltzmann-averaged activation free energy over conformer ensembles of both saddle channels (benzyl CH2, methoxycarbonyl and CF3 torsions), evaluated with a DLPNO-CCSD(T)/CBS-class electronic energy difference between them. Neither half is producible in this envelope. (i) The conformer axis needs one transition-state search per rotamer per channel; the observed cost of a single such search in this goal was 627-5471 s and of a single relaxed torsion scan 14213 s, against 10204 s of remaining engine wall -- the budget binding line states the remaining wall fits zero of the slowest nodes this goal ran. (ii) ORCA declares dlpno-ccsd(t) in its ab_initio domain, but a triple-zeta domain-based coupled-cluster single point on each 30-atom saddle exceeds the same remaining wall. The quantity itself IS delivered by node claim-requested-observable from the executed single points; what is not reachable here is the 0.5 kcal/mol precision. Arithmetic floor from receipts already in hand: the two measured terms alone (geometry convergence 0.158862, entropy model 0.356444 kcal/mol) combine in quadrature to 0.390399 kcal/mol, so the tolerance could only be met if BOTH the method term and the conformer/environment term were exactly zero -- and the thermochemistry receipts refute that directly, reporting four real modes below 50 cm-1 at each saddle (17.07/21.68/32.85/46.74 and 20.81/27.46/37.41/41.33 cm-1) contributing 37.46 and 36.17 kJ/mol of T*S under RRHO, with the receipt's own observation that two rotamers have differed by 0.4 kJ/mol in Gibbs energy on that term alone.
